## 1. Revised job posting

# Wind Turbine Technician I
**Northgale Renewables | Cedar Ridge Wind Farm**

Start or build your wind-energy career helping maintain the turbines at Cedar Ridge. This entry-level role supports turbine maintenance and troubleshooting, with training provided.

### Pay, schedule and benefits
- **Pay:** $31–$38 per hour, plus overtime pay.
- **Schedule:** Rotating 4×10 schedule (four 10-hour shifts), with overtime during the April–October maintenance season.
- **Benefits:** Medical and dental coverage, 401(k) match up to 4%, paid GWO training and a tool allowance.

### What you’ll do
- Help inspect, maintain and troubleshoot wind turbines.
- Follow safety procedures and communicate safety-critical information with the crew.
- Climb ladders in 80 m towers and work at height while wearing a harness.
- Work outdoors in heat and cold and lift up to 50 lb.

### Qualifications
- No degree required. A technical certificate or equivalent hands-on electrical, mechanical or military experience is preferred.
- This role is designed for candidates with 0–2 years of wind experience; no prior wind experience is required.
- GWO Basic Safety Training is required before starting applicable duties and must be completed within 90 days of hire if not already held. Northgale pays for this training.
- Ability to follow and give safety-critical instructions in English over radio.
- Valid driver’s licence required for operating company trucks.
- Ability to perform the essential job functions, including the physical tasks described above, with or without reasonable accommodation.

### Location and application
Cedar Ridge Wind Farm is approximately 40 minutes from town.

**Apply:** [careers.example.com/cedar-ridge-tech1](https://careers.example.com/cedar-ridge-tech1)  
**Questions or accommodation requests:** recruiting@example.com

Northgale Renewables is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome qualified applicants of all backgrounds and provide reasonable accommodations during the hiring process and employment.

## 2. Change log

| Original text | Revised text | Reason |
|---|---|---|
| “Wind Tech Rockstar Wanted!” | “Wind Turbine Technician I” | **Accuracy, inclusivity:** Uses the approved level and a clear, searchable title. |
| “young, energetic guy” | “Start or build your wind-energy career” | **Legal, inclusivity:** Removes age- and sex-based preferences. |
| “Recent graduates are ideal” | Entry-level role; no prior wind experience required | **Inclusivity:** Welcomes career changers and applicants of any age. |
| “climb turbines, troubleshoot and keep the blades spinning” | Specific maintenance, troubleshooting and safety duties | **Accuracy:** Replaces promotional shorthand with concrete work expectations. |
| “Bachelor’s degree in engineering” | No degree required; certificate or equivalent hands-on experience preferred | **Accuracy, inclusivity:** Matches the leveling guide and recognizes alternative pathways. |
| “Native English speaker” | Ability to follow and give safety-critical instructions in English over radio | **Legal, accuracy:** Replaces a national-origin-linked restriction with a job-related communication standard. |
| “2+ years of wind experience” | Role designed for 0–2 years; training provided | **Accuracy:** Corrects the experience level without making two years a hard eligibility ceiling. |
| No safety-training requirement | GWO training held or completed within 90 days, paid by Northgale; required before applicable duties | **Accuracy, safety:** Adds the required credential and avoids implying that untrained employees may perform restricted work. |
| “Must be able to climb 80 m towers and lift 50 lb” | Full physical demands, with or without reasonable accommodation | **Legal, accuracy:** Preserves essential tasks while allowing individualized accommodation consideration. |
| “Clean driving record” | Valid driver’s licence for company trucks | **Accuracy, inclusivity:** Removes an undefined screening standard not supported by the job facts. |
| “$28–34/hour plus overtime” | **$31–$38 per hour, plus overtime pay** | **Legal, accuracy:** Uses the approved, site-specific Technician I range to meet the stated pay-disclosure requirement. |
| “Work hard, play hard. Apply now!” | Schedule, seasonal overtime, benefits, location, direct application link and accommodation contact | **Accuracy, inclusivity:** Gives applicants useful decision-making information rather than a vague culture slogan. |
| No equal-opportunity statement | Equal-opportunity and reasonable-accommodation statement | **Legal, inclusivity:** Communicates fair access to hiring and employment. |

## 3. Square social recruiting graphic

### All on-image copy

> NORTHGALE RENEWABLES  
> NOW HIRING • CEDAR RIDGE WIND FARM  
> Wind Turbine

> Seasonal overtime: April–October  
> Medical + dental • 401(k) match up to 4%  
> Paid GWO training • Tool allowance  
> APPLY TODAY  
> careers.example.com/cedar-ridge-tech1  
> Questions or accommodation requests:  
> recruiting@example.com

### Layout by zone

- **Header, y=0–175:** Company name and hiring/site identifier; small decorative turbine illustration at upper right.
- **Role, y=200–335:** Large, left-aligned job title across two lines.
- **Pay, y=360–515:** High-contrast pay panel with the approved hourly range and overtime statement.
- **Role details, y=555–720:** Entry-level positioning, qualifications, schedule and seasonal overtime.
- **Benefits, y=750–820:** Two concise lines.
- **Application, y=855–1060:** Prominent application panel, readable URL and accommodation contact.

### Visual direction and accessibility

Use deep navy, off-white and teal with a warm yellow pay panel. Simple turbine line art signals the industry without depicting unsafe work practices or narrowing who belongs. Use bold sans-serif type, generous spacing and left alignment; keep essential copy out of illustrations. Do not rely on colour alone for meaning.

Publish the graphic with its text in the caption and a clickable application link. Suggested alt text: “Northgale Renewables is hiring a Wind Turbine Technician I at Cedar Ridge Wind Farm for $31–$38 per hour plus overtime. Entry level; training provided. See caption for schedule, benefits and application details.”
